message.abstract:
<jats:title>
                    A
                    <jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                  </jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This paper is devoted to study of integrable structures in superconformal field theory and more general coset CFT’s related to the affine Yangian Y(
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$ \hat{\mathfrak{gl}} $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mover>
                            <mml:mi>gl</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mo>̂</mml:mo>
                          </mml:mover>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    (2)). We derive the relation between the RLL and current realizations and prove Bethe anzatz equations for the spectrum of Integrals of Motion.
                  </jats:p>
title: Affine Yangian of $$ \mathfrak{gl} $$(2) and integrable structures of superconformal field theory
